name: opengrow
description: OpenGrow Cloudflare deployment: dashboard, OpenGrow-compatible API, SDK, and short links.

scripts.dashboard:cf-build: npm run cloudflare:config:dashboard && cross-env NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=https://go.vocostar.com NEXT_PUBLIC_API_PATH=/api/v1 NEXT_PUBLIC_CLIENT_ID=opengrow-vocostar NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL=https://grow.vocostar.com NEXT_PUBLIC_ENV=production npm --prefix apps/dashboard run cf:build
scripts.worker:check: npm run worker:typecheck && npm run worker:test && npm run cloudflare:config:api && cd workers/api && npx wrangler deploy --dry-run --config ../../deploy/generated/vocostar-api-production.jsonc
scripts.billing:types: node scripts/cloudflare-config.mjs --service billing --target vocostar --environment production && cd workers/billing && npx wrangler types --config ../../deploy/generated/vocostar-billing-production.jsonc
scripts.billing:check: npm run billing:types && npm run billing:typecheck && npm run billing:test && cd workers/billing && npx wrangler deploy --dry-run --config ../../deploy/generated/vocostar-billing-production.jsonc
scripts.billing:deploy: npm run cloudflare:deploy -- --service billing --target vocostar --environment production
scripts.messaging:typecheck: cd workers/messaging && npx tsc --noEmit && npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.runtime.json
scripts.messaging:test:runtime: node scripts/cloudflare-config.mjs --service messaging --target vocostar --environment production && npx vitest run --config workers/messaging/vitest.runtime.config.ts
scripts.messaging:test: npm run messaging:test:unit && npm run messaging:test:runtime
scripts.messaging:check: npm run messaging:typecheck && npm run messaging:test && cd workers/messaging && npx wrangler deploy --dry-run --config ../../deploy/generated/vocostar-messaging-production.jsonc
scripts.messaging:deploy: npm run cloudflare:deploy -- --service messaging --target vocostar --environment production
scripts.growth:typecheck: cd workers/growth && npx tsc --noEmit && npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.runtime.json
scripts.growth:test:runtime: node scripts/cloudflare-config.mjs --service growth --target vocostar --environment production && npx vitest run --config workers/growth/vitest.runtime.config.ts
scripts.growth:test: npm run growth:test:unit && npm run growth:test:runtime
scripts.growth:types: node scripts/cloudflare-config.mjs --service growth --target vocostar --environment production && cd workers/growth && npx wrangler types --config ../../deploy/generated/vocostar-growth-production.jsonc
scripts.growth:check: npm run growth:types && npm run growth:typecheck && npm run growth:test && cd workers/growth && npx wrangler deploy --dry-run --config ../../deploy/generated/vocostar-growth-production.jsonc
scripts.growth:deploy: npm run cloudflare:deploy -- --service growth --target vocostar --environment production
scripts.flutterflow-messaging:check: cd sdks/flutterflow_messaging && flutter analyze && flutter test
scripts.worker:deploy: npm run cloudflare:deploy -- --service api --target vocostar --environment production
scripts.typecheck: npm run worker:typecheck && npm run billing:typecheck && npm run messaging:typecheck && npm run growth:typecheck && npm run dashboard:typecheck && npm run purchases-js:typecheck
scripts.test: npm run dashboard:test && npm run worker:test && npm run billing:test && npm run messaging:test && npm run growth:test
scripts.test:e2e:real: cd apps/dashboard && PLAYWRIGHT_REAL_BACKEND=1 npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:all: npm run copy:check && npm run migration:inventory && npm run typecheck && npm run flutterflow-messaging:check && npm run test && npm run dashboard:cf-build && npm run worker:check
